items.title: Investors Continue to Expect Global Stagflation in BofA Survey
items.summary: Most investors expect the global economy to experience stagflation, or weak growth combined with high inflation, in the next 12 months, Bank of America's global fund manager survey for August shows.  The survey also shows a net 14% of investors expect stronger economic growth over the next 12 months, down from 21% last month.
